# Sequence Diagram — Update Token Description (PATCH /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId})

> 對應：EDD §4.9.6 `UpdateDescriptionUseCase`、PRD US-AUTH-005（GDPR Right to Rectification）。
> 含 Idempotency-Key（24h cached result）+ Optimistic Concurrency（`ExpectedVersion`）+ Cross-User 403 + Revoked 409。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User as ERP User / Token Owner
    participant Browser as Browser
    participant Ctrl as ApiTokensController
    participant UpdateUC as UpdateDescriptionUseCase
    participant IdempStore as IIdempotencyKeyStore (Redis)
    participant TokenRepo as IApiTokenRepository
    participant AuditRepo as IAuditLogRepository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (erp_token)

    User->>Browser: 編輯 Token 描述並送出
    Browser->>Ctrl: PATCH /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}\nIdempotency-Key: {uuid}\nIf-Match: W/"{version}"\nbody: {description}

    Ctrl->>Ctrl: 驗證 ERP Session (Authorize)
    Ctrl->>UpdateUC: ExecuteAsync(UpdateDescriptionCommand{TokenId, OperatorUserId, NewDescription, IdempotencyKey, ExpectedVersion})

    %% 1. Validation
    alt description 空白或長度 > 100
        UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Fail(422, validation_failed)
        Ctrl-->>Browser: 422 Unprocessable Entity\n{"error":"validation_failed"}
    else description 通過驗證
        %% 2. Idempotency replay check
        UpdateUC->>IdempStore: GetAsync<UpdateDescriptionResult>(operatorUserId, idempotencyKey)

        alt Idempotency replay (24h 內已執行過)
            IdempStore-->>UpdateUC: cached UpdateDescriptionResult
            UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Success(cachedResult)
            Ctrl-->>Browser: 200 OK\n(回應與首次相同；DB 不重複寫 audit log)
        else 首次呼叫 (cache miss)
            IdempStore-->>UpdateUC: null

            %% 3. Load token + auth + state checks
            UpdateUC->>TokenRepo: GetByIdForUpdateAsync(tokenId, ct)
            TokenRepo->>DB: SELECT * FROM erp_token.api_tokens WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE

            alt Token 不存在
                DB-->>TokenRepo: null
                TokenRepo-->>UpdateUC: null
                UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Fail(404, token_not_found)
                Ctrl-->>Browser: 404 Not Found
            else Token 存在
                DB-->>TokenRepo: ApiToken row (含 Version)
                TokenRepo-->>UpdateUC: ApiToken{userId, status, description, version}

                alt 跨使用者修改 (token.userId != operatorUserId AND not admin)
                    UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Fail(403, forbidden_cross_user)
                    Ctrl-->>Browser: 403 Forbidden\n{"error":"forbidden_cross_user"}
                else 已撤銷的 Token
                    UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Fail(409, token_revoked)
                    Ctrl-->>Browser: 409 Conflict\n{"error":"token_revoked"}
                else Optimistic concurrency 衝突 (token.Version != ExpectedVersion)
                    UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Fail(409, version_conflict)
                    Ctrl-->>Browser: 409 Conflict\n{"error":"version_conflict"}
                else 通過所有檢查
                    %% 4. Apply change
                    UpdateUC->>UpdateUC: oldDescription = token.Description
                    UpdateUC->>UpdateUC: token.UpdateDescription(newDescription)
                    Note over UpdateUC: status 不變（仍為 Active）\nVersion += 1\nUpdatedAt = UtcNow\nRaises ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent

                    UpdateUC->>DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION

                    UpdateUC->>TokenRepo: SaveChangesAsync()
                    TokenRepo->>DB: UPDATE erp_token.api_tokens SET description=$1, version=version+1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2 AND version=$3

                    %% 5. Append audit log (with before/after JSONB)
                    UpdateUC->>AuditRepo: AddAsync(TokenAuditLog.Record(action='describe_update', target_token_id, target_token_prefix, target_user_id, actor_user_id, actor_username, ip_address, user_agent, before_state={description:oldDescription, version:expectedVersion}, after_state={description:newDescription, version:newVersion}))
                    AuditRepo->>DB: INSERT INTO erp_token.token_audit_logs (action='describe_update', before_state JSONB, after_state JSONB, ...)

                    UpdateUC->>DB: COMMIT

                    %% 6. Cache idempotency result
                    UpdateUC->>IdempStore: SetAsync(operatorUserId, idempotencyKey, result, TTL=24h)

                    UpdateUC-->>Ctrl: Result.Success(UpdateDescriptionResult{tokenId, oldDescription, newDescription, updatedAt})
                    Ctrl-->>Browser: 200 OK\n{tokenId, oldDescription, newDescription, updatedAt}
                end
            end
        end
    end
```

## Flow Notes

| 步驟 | 說明 |
|------|------|
| Idempotency-Key | 客戶端產生 UUID；24h 內重發同 key 直接回傳第一次的 result（不重複寫 audit log）— US-AUTH-005 / AC-6 |
| `If-Match` / `ExpectedVersion` | Optimistic Concurrency Control；UPDATE WHERE version=$3，更新失敗即代表 race condition |
| `GetByIdForUpdateAsync` | 包含 row-level lock（PG `FOR UPDATE`），保證同一 token 並行修改不衝突 |
| `before_state` / `after_state` | JSONB 欄位記錄變更前後的 description + version；SCHEMA `ck_audit_logs_state_consistency` 強制 describe_update 必含兩者 |
| `status` 不變 | UpdateDescription 不改變 token status，仍為 Active；只 bump Version |
| 同一 TX | UPDATE api_tokens + INSERT token_audit_logs 必在同一 DB transaction |

## Error Path Summary

| 情境 | HTTP | Error Code | 對應 PRD AC |
|------|------|-----------|------------|
| 正常更新 | 200 | — | US-AUTH-005 / AC-1, AC-5 |
| description 空白或 > 100 字元 | 422 | `validation_failed` | US-AUTH-005 / AC-2 |
| Token 不存在（cross-user 探測 → 同回 404 / 403）| 404 / 403 | `token_not_found` / `forbidden_cross_user` | US-AUTH-005 / AC-3 |
| 跨使用者修改（非 admin） | 403 | `forbidden_cross_user` | US-AUTH-005 / AC-3 |
| 已撤銷 Token | 409 | `token_revoked` | US-AUTH-005 / AC-4 |
| Optimistic concurrency 衝突 | 409 | `version_conflict` | API.md §3.3 |
| Idempotency replay（同 result）| 200 | — | US-AUTH-005 / AC-6 |

## Domain Event

```text
ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent {
  TokenId, UserId, TokenPrefix, OldDescription, NewDescription
}
→ in-process publish to AuditLogBC（同 TX 內由 IAuditLogRepository.AddAsync 寫入）
```

## SCHEMA Alignment

| 欄位 | DDL | 用途 |
|------|-----|------|
| `erp_token.api_tokens.description` | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL | 變更目標 |
| `erp_token.api_tokens.updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | 由 trigger 維護 |
| `erp_token.token_audit_logs.action` | VARCHAR(32) CHECK in (..., 'describe_update', ...) | 4 值列舉 |
| `erp_token.token_audit_logs.before_state` | JSONB NOT NULL（when action='describe_update'）| 舊 description + version |
| `erp_token.token_audit_logs.after_state` | JSONB NOT NULL（when action='describe_update'）| 新 description + version |
| `erp_token.token_audit_logs.target_user_id` | VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL | token 擁有者；若 admin 操作則 ≠ actor_user_id |
